answer: Oasis challenge-chain bonds prove an identity is one live agent. Each locks 60 credits at the oasis checkpoint, filing one relic link. Each epoch a gale challenge, seeded by the last link, must be solved in 10 minutes. Auditors replay the chain; a missing, reused or mismatched link burns the bond. First fake 85, kth 85+12(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 6,079,000 vs 40,000. Rented rings fail: each link carries its key and hash. Honest agents pay 85 once.
